subject: Supplier portal activation failing — token binding mismatch on SSO
messages:
From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@novaparts.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novaparts.com
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 11:12:00 -0400
Subject: Trouble activating supplier account — keeps redirecting to IdP error

Hi Jonas,

We tried to accept the supplier invite you sent this morning, but when our users click the activation link the page redirects to our corporate IdP (idp.novaparts.com) and then returns an error: "Token binding mismatch". We've tested with three users across two browsers.

I attached a screenshot of the error and our SSO metadata export in case that helps. This is blocking AP — they need the supplier profile active to receive POs this week. Can you advise next steps?

Thanks,
Elena Gomez
Senior Procurement Manager
NovaParts Inc.
Attachment: screenshot-error-500.png (image/png), novaparts-sso-metadata.xml (application/xml)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@novaparts.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 11:38:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Trouble activating supplier account — keeps redirecting to IdP error

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick repro and attachments. Sorry you're blocked. A few quick clarifying Qs so we don't chase the wrong lead: 

- Is your IdP configured to enforce token binding / client certs? (We sometimes see this with stricter corporate IdP policies.)
- Can you confirm the activation link you're clicking matches the invite we sent (I.e., no link rewriters or security gateways in front of email?)
- If you have a short curl of the redirect chain (or the browser network trace) that would help — but the screenshot + metadata are already very useful.

Plan from our side: I'll loop Ben (backend SSO owner) and Marissa (ops) to scope a temporary workaround (pre-provision a guest account for immediate PO intake) while Ben triages the redirect/token-bind failure with engineering.

I'll follow up with a proposed time for a short debug call.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales (Procurement)
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@novaparts.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 12:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Trouble activating supplier account — keeps redirecting to IdP error

Jonas / Elena — quick update from the infra side: the error text "Token binding mismatch" usually indicates a mismatch between the public key presented by the client and the key expected from the IdP assertion (often due to a proxy or email security rewriting the link). Two immediate diagnostics:

1) Try opening the activation link in an incognito window and on a device not behind your corporate VPN / proxy.
2) If that fails, we can provide a pre-created, password-protected invite (temp account) and then flip the association to your corporate IdP after you confirm. That avoids interrupting POs.

If you can share a HAR/network trace we'll triage faster. I'm standing by and can pull the SSO logs once you confirm an example user/email.

Ben Carter
Platform-Identity Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@novaparts.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>

Thanks Ben — we spun up a test outside our VPN (incognito) and the same redirect happens. I've attached a full HAR file to our procurement address (procurement@novaparts.com) and included the idp metadata you asked for.

We are OK with a temporary account if you can set it up today. Priority: receive incoming PO and invoice routing. Once things are stable we'll coordinate an IdP rebind so future logins use our SSO.

Elena
